claim: vLLM 0.30.0 now serves the production Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 embeddings on the NativeStack WSL2 RTX 4090 host. Qualified first on an owned instance against production 0.25.0 (identical model files, flags and route), then switched by a systemd drop-in that changes only the binary path; the live service returned identical embeddings and identical top-10 code-index results after the switch.
limitations: One host (NativeStack, RTX 4090, WSL2 Windows driver 616.64) and one model/route (/v1/embeddings with Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16); not a claim about other GPUs, models or the /v2/embed route. NVIDIA's model card still names vllm==0.25.0 for BF16 /v2/embed serving.
Retrieval equality covers 8 gate texts and 5 live code-index queries (top-10), not an aggregate retrieval-quality benchmark.
0.30.0 relies on its pinned-memory fallback for WSL (PR #56908); the 0.29.0 UVA failure recorded in vllm-compatibility remains true for 0.29.0.
The 0.25.0 prefix is kept for rollback; the base unit still names it and only the drop-in points at 0.30.0.

data.install: uv 0.12.17 pip install vllm==0.30.0 --exclude-newer 2026-09-25T23:59:59Z into a new $ECO/tools/vllm-0.30.0 prefix (torch 2.13.0+cu130, triton 3.7.1, flashinfer-python 0.6.18.post1)

security_advisories_closed.GHSA-25q3-v2hm-8vpf: high; negative token id in /v1/embeddings or /pooling kills the engine; patched 0.28.0
security_advisories_closed.GHSA-5fj9-pfhr-6j48: medium; unbounded Prometheus label cardinality in the Rust frontend; patched 0.30.0

data.wsl_fix: vllm-project/vllm PR #56908 (pinned-memory fallback), merged 2026-09-15; the owned instance logged the fallback warning and started cleanly

qualification_owned_instance.mini_corpus_top10_overlap: 10/10 on each of 10 queries (10 x 50 corpus)

production_switch.method: systemd --user drop-in native-stack-embeddings.service.d/override.conf; ExecStart binary path only
production_switch.rollback: rm the drop-in, systemctl --user daemon-reload, systemctl --user restart native-stack-embeddings

data.independent_review: A separate reviewer agent re-ran the version/wheel, model-dir hash, advisory, production-health and gate-arithmetic checks and rated the qualification switch-ready.
